facts.note: Previously, in the late 19th century latecomers to ball games were cordoned off into standing-room areas in foul territory. … this area became known as the "bullpen" (the name stayed when relief pitchers began warming up there)

facts.claim: 1877년 신시내티 인콰이어러 첫 기록, 'three for a quarter crowd'
facts.note: the earliest recorded use of "bullpen" in relation to baseball is in a Cincinnati Enquirer article (May 7, 1877): "The bull-pen at the Cincinnati grounds with its 'three for a quarter crowd' has lost its usefulness."
The term first appeared in wide use shortly after the turn of the 20th century
